data.name: 1,2,4-Trichlorobenzene with Water
measurement_methods: The water content in the sample was determined by a modified Karl Fischer titration.
mixing_methods: Addition of 2 ml H_2O to 100 ml C_6H_3CI_3 in an equilibrium flask was performed in a dry box.
The closed flask was then placed in a water thermostat bath and the assembly was shaken for 90 minutes.

publication_references.citation: Eidinoff, M.L. In "Production of Heavy Water", National Nuclear Energy Series Division III-Vol. 4F, Murphy, G.M.; Urey, H. C.; Kirshenbaum, I., Eds.; McGraw-Hill: New York, 1955; Part II, Chapter 7, pp 129-44.
